name: Copy Field
tagline: A text column with a copy-to-clipboard button and a confirmation.

limitations: The copy button cannot reach the clipboard in the demo. The harness iframe is sandboxed to allow-scripts on an opaque origin with no clipboard-write permission, which denies navigator.clipboard and the execCommand fallback alike — so pressing Copy shows the control's failure message rather than putting anything on your clipboard

That failure state is worth seeing, because it is the same one a real form produces when an administrator's Permissions-Policy withholds the clipboard: the button says so instead of pretending it worked
Everything else is real — typing, the disabled button on an empty value, the read-only state, and the live-region announcement that a screen reader hears

presets.name: Default
presets.description: A reference number ready to copy. Press the button to see the confirmation.

presets.name: Nothing to copy
presets.description: An empty column. The button is disabled, because a button that copies an empty string is a button that lies about having done something.

presets.name: A long value
presets.description: The field shrinks and the button holds its size, which is the layout a narrow canvas screen actually produces.
